set.approach: From the Roaring Brook parking area and campground, hike the Chimney Pond Trail, branch onto the cut-off signed for North Basin, then follow the basin trail to the viewpoint at Blueberry Knoll. Follow the cairns toward the wall, pass the pond on its right side and rock-hop to the base of the cliff; the last stretch needs some bushwhacking through tight trees. The line lies toward the right-hand end of the big headwall.

review.notes: NOTE: MP route page 107652125 named Hanta Yo is a different climb in New Hampshire (Longstack Precipice), not used.
